note: Triple-differential (Eν slice x cosθμ x Pμ) inclusive νμ CC cross section on argon, MicroBooNE, BNB, 6.4e20 POT

distributions.name: d²σ(E_ν)/dcosθ_μdP_μ
distributions.provenance: arXiv:2307.06413 e-print ancillary files anc/microboone_cc_inclusive_cross_section.txt (+ .root, cross-checked) and anc/microboone_cc_inclusive_cov_matrix.txt; this is the d^2\sigma(E_\nu)/d\cos\theta_\mu dP_\mu three-dimensional result (Fig. 'xs_enu' / 1_numuCC_3D_Enu_uboone.pdf), distinct from the headline d^3\sigma/dE_vis dcos\theta dP_\mu measurement (Evis-based, whose machine-readable files were not included in this e-print's ancillary bundle). Y-axis label and 1e-36 scale read directly from the PDF text layer of Fig. 'xs_enu': 'd^2\sigma(E_\nu)/dP_\mu dcos\theta_\mu (cm^2/GeV/Ar)  x10^-36'. Errors are total (stat+syst) from the released covariance diagonal, exactly matching the txt file's 'uncertainty' column.

covariance.note: full 138x138 total (stat+syst) covariance over all bins (Eν panel, then cosθμ series, then Pμ bin, in file order), in raw units matching the CSV values (i.e. (10^-36 cm^2/(GeV/c)/Ar)^2); sqrt(diag) matches the released per-bin uncertainty exactly.
